package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v3/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1"
	"github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v3/workflow/validate"
	"sigs.k8s.io/yaml"
)

func main() {
	failed := 0
	for _, f := range os.Args[1:] {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(f)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		var wt v1alpha1.WorkflowTemplate
		if err := yaml.UnmarshalStrict(data, &wt); err != nil {
			fmt.Println(f, "strict decode:", err)
			failed++
			continue
		}
		get := validate.ValidateOpts{Lint: true}
		if err := validate.ValidateWorkflowTemplate(nil, nil, &wt, nil, get); err != nil {
			fmt.Println(f, "validate:", err)
			failed++
			continue
		}
		fmt.Println(f, "ok")
	}
	if failed > 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
